An '''orchestrion''' was a musical instrument capable of producing a wide variety of sound effects. The [[Brentaal Hall Conservatory]] had an antique orchestrion said to be commissioned by [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] herself.<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref>
